replacements.Distinguir en un mismo turno la causa ra: Distinguish the root cause, recovery, first harmful observable, and final outcome within one turn, while seeing what evidence each layer contributes.
replacements.Un timeline causal alinea runtime, conve: A causal timeline aligns runtime, conversation, media, and outcome. An internal timeout happens before the symptom; fallback restores the ability to respond, but the delay appears later as the first harmful observable while the business outcome can still be correct. The four layers converge on a multidimensional diagnosis.
replacements.Una tabla puede enumerar symptom/cause/r: A table can enumerate symptom/cause/recovery/outcome, but it does not show that they occur at different times and in different domains, or that recovery can prevent an outcome failure without eliminating perceived impact. The geometry lets the reader follow the causal chain before reading every label.
replacements.Grafo causal de evidencia de un turno qu: Causal evidence graph for one turn separating root cause, recovery, first harmful observable, and outcome
replacements.El primer daño visible no tiene por qué: The first visible harm does not have to be the root cause
replacements.Este turno termina con la tarea correcta: This turn completes the right task, but it was not clean: an internal timeout triggers fallback and the user receives the response late.
replacements.Una cadena causal, cuatro fuentes de evi: One causal chain, four evidence sources
replacements.El tiempo va de izquierda a derecha. Las: Time runs left to right. Lanes separate domains; arrows show which event explains which.
replacements.Grafo desplazable de runtime, conversaci: Scrollable graph of runtime, conversation, media, and outcome with causal chain and diagnosis
replacements.Causa raíz, recuperación, primer observa: Root cause, recovery, first harmful observable, and outcome of one turn
replacements.Un timeout del proveedor aparece primero: A provider timeout appears first in the runtime lane. Fallback recovers generation. Later, the delay crosses the experience budget and becomes the first harmful observable in media. The conversation continues and the business outcome ends in success. The four lanes converge on a diagnosis that keeps cause, recovery, symptom, impact, and outcome separate.
replacements.un turno puede ser correcto y degradado: a turn can be correct and degraded
replacements.No colapses estas señales en una sola et: Do not collapse these signals into a single “LLM_ERROR” label.
replacements.La causa ocurre en runtime; el primer da: The cause occurs in runtime; the first harm appears later in media; fallback recovers; the business outcome remains SUCCESS.
replacements.Primer observable dañino ≠ causa raíz ≠: First harmful observable ≠ root cause ≠ outcome.
replacements.Guarda también la recuperación. Un error: Keep recovery as a separate dimension too. A recovered internal error may not damage the outcome, and a textually correct answer can coexist with a degraded experience.
